name: Cable-compartment door interlock
summary: Relates access to the cable compartment to the equipment states defined by its interlocking scheme.
description: Relates access to the cable compartment to the equipment states defined by its interlocking scheme. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Door and earthing conditions” at the input and “Door interlock state” at the output. Compartment access requires the complete equipment procedure.
